summaries.title: From Pixels to Actions - Towards Native Vision-Language-Action Policies
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**具身智能与物理AI**（Embodied & VLA）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **From Pixels to Actions -** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖视觉-语言-动作模型（Vision-Language-Action Model (VLA)）。核心论点主张：We introduce NEO-VLA, a structurally encoder-free vision-language-action framework。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：This raises a fundamental question: should action policies inherit a fixed visual endpoint, or directly access evolving visual computation?。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Native architectures outperform encoder-based counterparts under controlled comparisons; full fine-tuning reduces but does not erase the gap, and additional scale alone cannot recover...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 55 赞，出自 MMLab@NTU），本工作为突破 **小语言模型与端侧推理 (SLM & Edge)、视觉-语言与长视频理解 (VLM & Video)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供项目主页与可视化案例参考。

summaries.title: Turns Matter: Advancing Streaming Video RL via Turn-Level Credit
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**训练与强化学习**（Training & RL）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「强化学习信用分配困难与训练不稳定性」痛点，作者围绕 **Turns Matter** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖群组相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)），并引入 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：We propose TurnWise, a turn-level GRPO framework that aligns learning with individual streaming decisions。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用强化学习策略优化与奖励驱动对齐。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Such shared credit can reinforce redundant replies after earlier successes and discourage useful follow-ups after earlier failures。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Extensive experiments show our method outperforms prior RL approaches for streaming video understanding）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 51 赞），本工作为突破 **可验证奖励与群组策略优化 (RLVR/GRPO)、视觉-语言与长视频理解 (VLM & Video)** 中的「强化学习信用分配困难与训练不稳定性」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: UniRestorer++: Scalable Universal Image Restoration with Multi-Granularity Degradation Modeling

summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用免训练（Training-Free）/零样本适配机制、稀疏专家路由与解耦表征设计。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Increasing backbone depth and width can lead to performance saturation, while degradation-aware specialization depends on accurate degradation estimation and is...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（UniRestorer++ achieves state-of-the-art performance across benchmarks and demonstrates zero-shot generalization and few-shot transfer on real-world images）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 2 赞），本工作为突破 **混合专家与动态深度 (MoE/MoD)、全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 中的「跨域/跨本体分布外泛化受限」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: Koopman Generative Operators for Efficient Probabilistic Time-Series Forecasting
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**视觉生成与世界模型**（Vision & World）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「推理延迟与高昂计算开销、对人工先验规则或定制化流水线的过度依赖」痛点，作者围绕 **Koopman Generative Operators for Efficient** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖流匹配（Flow Matching），并引入 Koopman Generative Operator (KGO), Adaptive Uncertainty Gate (AUG) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：We introduce the Koopman Generative Operator (KGO), a probabilistic forecasting method that conceptualizes prediction as the evolution of structured uncertainty。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用迭代去噪生成/流匹配建模。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：KGO integrates three core components: (1) Koopman Patch Embedding (KoPE) for temporally consistent latent trajectory extrapolation; (2) Koopman Flow...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **13/17, 16/17, 25× reduction**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（By unifying these components, KGO achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on 13/17 ProbTS benchmarks in CRPS and 16/17...；These results position KGO as a practical and principled framework that advances the accuracy-efficiency trade-off...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 2 赞，出自 The Sequential Learning Group），本工作为突破 **图像扩散与流匹配生成 (Diffusion & Flow)、全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 中的「推理延迟与高昂计算开销」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: LiveFoley: Dynamic Real-Time Video-to-Audio Generation for Immersive Interactive Worlds
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**多模态与统一基座**（Multimodal）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「推理延迟与高昂计算开销」痛点，作者围绕 **LiveFoley** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖多模态与统一基座（Multimodal），并引入 Streaming video-to-audio (V2A) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：To this end, we present LiveFoley, a streaming causal autoregressive diffusion architecture that addresses both bottlenecks with imperceptible latency。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用迭代去噪生成/流匹配建模。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：To this end, we present LiveFoley, a streaming causal autoregressive diffusion architecture that addresses both bottlenecks with imperceptible latency。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Extensive experiments demonstrate that LiveFoley matches offline models in temporal alignment and leads streaming systems in generation quality）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 1 赞），本工作为突破 **原生全模态与语音交互 (Omni & Audio)** 中的「推理延迟与高昂计算开销」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: Ask, Don't Equip: Question-Driven Coding Agents for Deep Kernel Optimization
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**智能体与代码工程**（Agents & SWE）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Ask, Don't Equip** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、智能体运行脚手架（Agentic Harness）。核心论点主张：We present KernelSeek, a question-driven agent that makes an existing CUDA kernel faster with no operator-specific knowledge and no faster implementation to imitate: a...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用底层算子融合、量化压缩与执行流加速、感知-规划-工具执行闭环智能体架构、动态记忆槽更新与检索增强机制。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Open-ended agents let a self-directed model mutate a population of kernels and pay for the freedom in trials: thousands of evaluations, repeated edits, and wrong...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **0.50x, 1.13x, 1.16x, 1.46x**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（We release the kernels, harness, question bank, and all traces）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 0 赞，出自 Snowflake），本工作为突破 **KV缓存压缩与推测解码 (KV & Speculative)、智能体脚手架、工具与技能 (Harness & Skills)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**推理与测试时计算**（Reasoning & TTC）赛道，属于实证与机理剖析。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Why Pay for Long Reasoning** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖推理与测试时计算（Reasoning & TTC）。核心论点主张：We investigate whether open-weight models can generate less verbose reasoning by changing the form of their own earlier thoughts, without retraining。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Progress in proprietary models motivates this goal, yet their hidden scratchpads limit direct study of how it is achieved。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（These findings identify reasoning history as one way to reduce future reasoning-token use and motivate model-specific compaction policies evaluated for both efficiency and retained...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 0 赞），本工作修正了对 **推理与测试时计算** 的经验性直觉假设，为后续算法改进指明了真正起作用的因果关键点；提供项目主页与可视化案例参考。

summaries.title: DRAP: Dynamics-Risk Adaptive Plasticity for Continual Learning in Physical AI
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**AI4Science与记忆评测**（Science & Eval）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「显存占用与端侧资源受限」痛点，作者围绕 **DRAP** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖持续学习（Continual Learning），并引入 work introduces Dynamics-Risk Adaptive Plasticity (DRAP) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：Each deviation may move the agent outside the training distribution, increase subsequent prediction errors, and ultimately cause closed-loop task failure。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用动态记忆槽更新与检索增强机制。评测基准/数据集涵盖 **LIBERO**。实验设计与验证细节：This work introduces Dynamics-Risk Adaptive Plasticity (DRAP), a replay-free method that estimates the historical importance of adaptable model...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Compared with standard AdamW fine-tuning and EWC, the results show substantially improved retention of previously learned behaviors while preserving strong new-suite acquisition）。
